description: Address semantic review issues: rate limiting, vpnapi.io caching, privacy note accuracy, error logging, dead CSS cleanup
steps: Step 1 - Add rate limiting to /api/ghost-scan using _check_rate_limit infrastructure with a new _rate_store_ghost dict and 2-second limit
Step 2 - Add in-memory cache for vpnapi.io responses keyed on IP with 60-second TTL
Step 3 - Update privacy note in templates/index.html to disclose third-party VPN detection service
Step 4 - Replace bare except Exception in ghost_scan with app.logger.warning for operational visibility
Step 5 - Remove dead .social-section, .social-grid, .social-btn rules from static/css/responsive.css
acceptance_criteria: /api/ghost-scan returns 429 when called faster than 2 seconds per IP
Repeated requests from the same IP within 60s do not call vpnapi.io again
Privacy note mentions third-party service for VPN detection
vpnapi.io failures are logged via app.logger.warning
No .social-section, .social-grid, or .social-btn rules remain in responsive.css
verification: Run: python -c "import app; print('OK')" to verify no import errors
Run: grep -n 'rate_store_ghost' app.py to confirm rate limiting added
Run: grep -n '_ghost_vpn_cache' app.py to confirm caching added
Run: grep -n 'app.logger.warning' app.py to confirm logging in ghost_scan
Run: grep -n 'pihak ketiga' templates/index.html to confirm privacy note updated
Run: grep -c 'social-section\|social-grid\|social-btn' static/css/responsive.css to confirm dead rules removed (should be 0)
